cour-cold.scope:
Three real disk-backed Chromium restarts: owner walking, explicitly waiting,
and all three arrived with memories heard. Seed-only scripted setup; resumed HTML
is byte-identical production without test bridge or MemoryStorage. No IGN return,
power-cut, human campaign or cross-browser certification.

birds-cold.scope:
Six disk-backed Chromium restarts for postal pigeons and consignment gabians.
Seed-only fixtures prepare native saves. Resume loads byte-identical production HTML
at the same file URL, clicks Continue, and has no seed bridge or fake storage.
Scripted positions and authored interiors only; no power-cut or real IGN certification.

rats-cold.scope: Native disk-backed Chromium LocalStorage at an offline file URL and full process restart followed by native Continue on unchanged production HTML. Fixture-only seed constructs the authored depot and prepares its checkpoint through runtime helpers; it does not verify port travel. Observer pauses immediately after Continue for exact comparison. No real IGN exterior return, power-loss or human campaign certification.

limits: 55 existing regional IDs, not 55 new or unique models; three additional shared presentation profiles.
49 weapon concepts and 98 creature/automaton designations are documentary records, not completed content; exact-name matching does not infer aliases.
Numeric weapon data, ammunition ownership and rewards unchanged; no new save schema.
Browser suites use scripted origins/positions and isolated MemoryStorage with software rendering; no full human campaign or exhaustive IGN traversal.
When requested, cold suites cover existing courtyard/birds/rats with orderly Chromium restart, not power loss or every browser. No new arsenal-specific disk restart scenario.
